full_page.content:
Page 9 Nov. 26 Albert Nichols - about fifty, convert - strept infection & heart trouble.
29 Mrs. Anna Kendzierski - 48 - operated on for tripple goitre (in Grace Hospital) three yrs ago, was thought to be dead. She had enrolled herself in Ser. Mass As'n before hospital ....... It was in a non Cath. hospital .... Two days after operation came to self and asked "Where is my rosary?" "O yes", the nurse answered. "They are here in the drawer. They must have saved you ... " She asks for prayers in thanksgiving - is now in ... O.K. Deo Grat.
30 V. Sister M. Bozislava - 39 - doctoring for cancer on eylid .... anxious to get well to do God's work .-
For December 1st 1937
Mrs. Mary Grady - 58 - abcess on liver on gall bl. Operation in July refused to heal - always draining. At that time her daugh- ter enrolled her and promised to promote devotion to the Sacred Heart ...... Mother was supposed to go back to Ann Arbor Hosp. She is now O.K. ...
Mrs. Gert. Baker - 47 - operation cancer feared
Page 10
Gorden Nett - 31 - prayed for last Wednesday - as unconscious and Saturday - recognized his sister next day - not out of danger but improving
Mrs. Ada Noteboert - 481 Manistique
Loretta Reed - 32 - had serious operation in October - Doctors were surprise at her not returning to hospital .... did own washing yester-
Page 11 Dec. 8th
1937, December Mary Sill - 45 -
Lawrence Reno - 42 - hicoughs - kidney - high-blood Little - nephew of Good Shep. nun - born with a cataract on one eye Henry F. Mueller - 31 - neglecting wife and family - worst of all his own soul and his God & Creator
